what: 1. Build a multiband image from single-band TIFs
title: Getting started with saltbush
text: example data ships five single-band TIFs drone flight Fowlers Gap, NSW (blue, green, red, red_edge, nir).
code: input_dir <- system.file("extdata/create_multiband_image",                          package = "saltbush")  multiband <- create_multiband_image(   input_dir,   desired_band_order = c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir"),   output_dir = tempdir(),   return_raster = TRUE )

what: 2. Extract pixel values inside areas of interest
title: Getting started with saltbush
text: combine multiband image area--interest shapefile. package ships small aggregated raster matching AOI demonstration:
code: raster_files <- list.files(   system.file("extdata/example", package = "saltbush"),   pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE )  aoi_files <- list.files(   system.file("extdata/aoi", package = "saltbush"),   pattern = "NSABHC0009_aoi\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE )  pixel_values <- extract_pixel_values(   raster_files, aoi_files,   c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir") ) head(pixel_values) #>    site_name       blue      green        red   red_edge        nir aoi_id #> 1 NSABHC0009 0.05511368 0.05600401 0.07633078 0.06699516 0.08160288      1 #> 2 NSABHC0009 0.06224341 0.06684195 0.09760323 0.08534835 0.10119278      1 #> 3 NSABHC0009 0.05985198 0.06332091 0.08991133 0.07894940 0.09560681      1 #> 4 NSABHC0009 0.05927841 0.06296582 0.08709560 0.07646009 0.09347322      1 #> 5 NSABHC0009 0.04356062 0.04587397 0.06008397 0.05540059 0.07216450      1 #> 6 NSABHC0009 0.03945594 0.03824322 0.04755034 0.04384791 0.05770193      1

title: Getting started with saltbush
text: calculate_spectral_metrics() returns three metrics per AOI: CV — coefficient variation SV — spectral variance CHV — convex hull volume
code: metrics <- calculate_spectral_metrics(   pixel_values,   wavelengths = c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir"),   masked = FALSE,   rarefaction = FALSE ) metrics #>          site aoi_id       CV          SV          CHV image_type #>        <char>  <num>    <num>       <num>        <num>     <char> #> 1: NSABHC0009      1 0.334488 0.001761305 3.347609e-10   unmasked

title: Getting started with saltbush
text: --ground side, package ships cached AusPlots point-intercept dataset site (NSABHC0009) worked example need network access: returned metrics species richness, Shannon’s diversity, Simpson’s diversity, Pielou’s evenness, exponential Shannon’s, inverse Simpson’s. pull fresh query AusPlots database (query plots), use ausplotsR::get_ausplots():
code: field_diversity <- calculate_field_diversity(ausplots_NSABHC0009) field_diversity$taxonomic_diversity #>        site_unique site_location_name species_richness shannon_diversity #> 1 NSABHC0009-58026         NSABHC0009               52          3.056908 #> 2 NSABHC0009-53604         NSABHC0009               38          2.843074 #>   simpson_diversity pielou_evenness exp_shannon inv_simpson #> 1         0.9203249       0.7736571    21.26171    12.55097 #> 2         0.9043699       0.7815826    17.16846    10.45696 my.data <- ausplotsR::get_ausplots(   my.Plot_IDs = c("NSABHC0009"), veg.PI = TRUE ) calculate_field_diversity(my.data$veg.PI)

Specifically used package test Australian arid zone. results suggest methods perform much better others. code reproduces full analysis available adelegem/multispectral_drone_svh.

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
code: install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("traitecoevo/saltbush", build_vignettes = TRUE)

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: saltbush ships small synthetic dataset cached AusPlots query can try --ground side without external data: --sky side, package bundles small clip multispectral drone imagery Fowlers Gap, NSW can turn spectral metrics: five spectral bands clip:  true-colour composite clip:  spectral metrics area interest:
code: field_diversity <- calculate_field_diversity(ausplots_NSABHC0009) field_diversity$taxonomic_diversity #>        site_unique site_location_name species_richness shannon_diversity #> 1 NSABHC0009-58026         NSABHC0009               52          3.056908 #> 2 NSABHC0009-53604         NSABHC0009               38          2.843074 #>   simpson_diversity pielou_evenness exp_shannon inv_simpson #> 1         0.9203249       0.7736571    21.26171    12.55097 #> 2         0.9043699       0.7815826    17.16846    10.45696 raster_files <- list.files(   system.file("extdata/example", package = "saltbush"),   pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE ) aoi_files <- list.files(   system.file("extdata/aoi", package = "saltbush"),   pattern = "NSABHC0009_aoi\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE ) pixel_values <- extract_pixel_values(   raster_files, aoi_files,   c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir") ) metrics <- calculate_spectral_metrics(   pixel_values,   wavelengths = c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir"),   masked = FALSE, rarefaction = FALSE ) drone <- terra::rast(raster_files) terra::plot(drone) terra::plotRGB(drone, r = 3, g = 2, b = 1, stretch = "hist") metrics #>          site aoi_id       CV          SV          CHV image_type #>        <char>  <num>    <num>       <num>        <num>     <char> #> 1: NSABHC0009      1 0.334488 0.001761305 3.347609e-10   unmasked

what: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
text: cached subset point-intercept (veg.PI) table AusPlots site NSABHC0009 Fowlers Gap, NSW. Saved package dataset worked example tests require live access AusPlots database.

title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
code: data(ausplots_NSABHC0009)

title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
text: data frame one row per point-intercept hit: site_unique Character. Unique site/visit identifier. site_location_name Character. Site identifier. site_location_visit_id Integer. AusPlots visit identifier. transect Character. Transect identifier within visit. point_number Integer. Point number along transect. standardised_name Character. Standardised species name.

title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
text: Cached ausplotsR::get_ausplots() .Plot_IDs = "NSABHC0009". See data-raw/ausplots_NSABHC0009.R.

title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
text: columns used saltbush plus useful identifiers retained — taxonomy columns free-text fields dropped keep file small.

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_cv
text: Calculates CV, SV, CHV pixel values dataframe columns wavelength, site_name, aoi_id. help file applies functions calculate_cv, calculate_sv, calculate_chv_nopca, calculate_spectral_metrics.

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_cv
code: calculate_cv(   pixel_values_df,   wavelengths,   rarefaction = FALSE,   min_points = NULL,   n = NULL,   seed = NULL )

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_cv
text: pixel_values_df data frame containing pixel values, typically obtained extract_pixel_values function. wavelengths list wavelengths correspond column names pixel_values_df. rarefaction Logical; TRUE, applies rarefaction step increases processing time. min_points Integer; minimum number pixels per aoi standardize uneven pixel numbers across sites (used rarefaction = TRUE). n Integer; number subset permutations rarefaction = TRUE. seed Integer NULL; provided, set.seed(seed) called start function rarefaction sampling reproducible. Default NULL preserves prior unseeded behaviour.

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_cv
text: dataframe containing spectral metrics aoi within site/raster.

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_cv
code: set.seed(123) df <- data.frame(   site_name = rep(c("site_one", "site_two", "site_three", "site_four"), each = 5000),   aoi_id = 1,   blue = runif(20000, min = 0, max = 1),   green = runif(20000, min = 0, max = 1),   red = runif(20000, min = 0, max = 1),   red_edge = runif(20000, min = 0, max = 1),   nir = runif(20000, min = 0, max = 1)) spectral_metrics <- calculate_spectral_metrics(df,    wavelengths = c('blue','green','red','red_edge','nir'),    rarefaction = TRUE, min_points = 50, n = 5)

title: Calculate field diversity — calculate_field_diversity
text: Takes ausplot survey data calculates field diversity grouping specified group_by_cols. default groups site_unique (one row per survey visit, matching prior behaviour); passing c("site_unique", "subplot_id") (vector column names survey_data) computes diversity finer granularity.

title: Calculate field diversity — calculate_field_diversity
code: calculate_field_diversity(survey_data, group_by_cols = "site_unique")

title: Calculate field diversity — calculate_field_diversity
text: survey_data df obtained ausplotsR package survey data appropriate sites group_by_cols character vector column names survey_data group . Defaults "site_unique", gives one row per survey visit. Pass e.g. c("site_unique", "subplot_id") compute diversity per subplot within site.

title: Calculate field diversity — calculate_field_diversity
text: list, containing 'taxonomic_diversity' - values species richness, shannon's index, simpsons index, exponential shannon's, inverse simpson, pielou's evenness, one row per unique combination group_by_cols, 'community_matrices' - list per-group community matrices keyed grouping values; matrix group_by_cols leading id columns followed one column per species.

title: Create masked raster from multiband image — create_masked_raster
text: input directory containing multiple ENVI TIF files, single file, character vector file paths. output_dir directory masked raster(s) saved. ndvi_threshold Numeric. NDVI threshold masking (pixels NDVI values masked non-vegetation). nir_threshold Numeric. NIR threshold masking (pixels NIR values masked shadows). ndvi_threshold_df Optional. data frame two columns: site (site identifiers) threshold (NDVI threshold values site). site values must match beginning input file names. nir_threshold_df Optional. data frame two columns: site (site identifiers) threshold (NIR threshold values site). site values must match beginning input file names. red_band_index Integer. index (layer number) red band input raster. TRUE, masked raster object returned. Default FALSE.

title: saltbush 0.1.0
text: Initial release. --sky spectral diversity: build multiband images single-band drone TIFs (create_multiband_image()), mask non-vegetation pixels NDVI/NIR thresholds (create_masked_raster(), find_optimum_thresholds()), extract per-AOI pixel values (extract_pixel_values()), compute spectral metrics — coefficient variation, spectral variance, convex hull volume (calculate_spectral_metrics() underlying calculate_cv(), calculate_sv(), calculate_chv_nopca()). --ground taxonomic diversity AusPlots point-intercept surveys (calculate_field_diversity()): species richness, Shannon, Simpson, Pielou’s evenness, exponential Shannon, inverse Simpson. Bundled example data (synthetic_survey, ausplots_NSABHC0009, example drone rasters) examples, tests, vignette run offline.
